evidence.scope: Owned temporary Edge, localhost DEV isolated QA; no physical phone/GPS claim
evidence.fifthStatePolicy: No fabricated busy state for synchronous navigation, tabs, sliders or switches. Real menu upcoming, calibration Undo, activity transition, and pending-location states are measured separately.

semanticEquivalence.reason: Pointerdown immediately opens the real listbox; its caret/expanded feedback is accepted without adding a second button animation.

The selected tab keeps its selection color/opacity while disabled. The owning dialog exposes aria-busy and the primary action shows a spinner and pending label, so the brief whole-page transition supplies busy feedback.

semanticEquivalence.controls: Synchronous menu navigation, category tabs, sliders and switches
semanticEquivalence.reason: No asynchronous busy phase is supported; pending/disabled states are not fabricated to fill a universal five-state matrix.

command.name: setSafeAreaInsetsOverride
command.description:
Overrides the values for env(safe-area-inset-*) and env(safe-area-max-inset-*). Unset values will cause the
respective variables to be undefined, even if previously overridden.
